_readme: One place for every affiliate placement. url must point to an existing /go/ page. Edit wording here; never edit the /go/ pages' affiliate URLs or tags. Picks are for a tech-news audience: the product type the article is about, never security add-ons on unrelated stories. 'general' shows nothing.

yubikey.name: YubiKey hardware security keys
yubikey.card_title: Stop stolen passwords from being enough
yubikey.card_text: Hardware security keys (FIDO2) are tied to the real website, so a phishing page cannot use them even if someone hands over a password.
yubikey.kit_line: Phishing-resistant sign-in for email, cloud and exchange accounts

contabo-storage.name: Contabo Object Storage
contabo-storage.card_title: Room for big files and backups
contabo-storage.card_text: S3-compatible object storage holds datasets, media libraries and backups at a flat monthly price.
contabo-storage.kit_line: S3-compatible storage for datasets, media and backups

contabo-dedicated.name: Contabo dedicated servers
contabo-dedicated.kit_line: A whole physical server for heavier workloads
contabo-dedicated.card_title: When a shared server is not enough
contabo-dedicated.card_text: A dedicated server gives one project all of a machine's processor, memory and disks.

contabo-vps.name: Contabo Core VPS
contabo-vps.kit_line: A low-cost cloud server for testing software and small projects
contabo-vps.card_title: Try it on your own server
contabo-vps.card_text: A low-cost cloud server is enough to run open-source software, test an API or host a small project, billed monthly.

surfshark-id.name: Surfshark Alternative ID
surfshark-id.kit_line: Masked email addresses so one leak does not expose your real inbox

surfshark-vpn.name: Surfshark VPN
surfshark-vpn.card_title: Protect traffic on networks you do not control
surfshark-vpn.card_text: A VPN encrypts your connection on public and shared Wi-Fi, so people on the same network cannot read or tamper with it.
surfshark-vpn.kit_line: Encrypted traffic on public and shared Wi-Fi

encrypted-ssd.name: Hardware-encrypted SSDs
encrypted-ssd.kit_line: An offline, encrypted copy of your most important files
encrypted-ssd.card_text: An encrypted drive that stays unplugged cannot be reached by ransomware or a hijacked cloud account.

ups-backup.name: UPS battery backups
ups-backup.kit_line: Keeps your router and PC running through short power cuts

firewall.name: Network firewall appliances
firewall.kit_line: Separates lab and smart devices from the rest of your network

gearup.name: GearUP
gearup.kit_line: Routing optimizer for unstable or high-latency connections
gearup.card_text: GearUP routes game and app traffic over alternative network paths, aiming to reduce latency and packet loss on unreliable connections.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.kit_line: AI voice generation for narration, videos and podcasts
elevenlabs.card_text: ElevenLabs generates voiceovers and narration from text, in many voices and languages.

portable-ssd.name: Portable SSDs
portable-ssd.card_title: More room for photos, games and projects
portable-ssd.card_text: A pocket-sized SSD adds fast storage to a laptop, console or phone over USB-C.
portable-ssd.kit_line: Fast, pocket-sized storage for laptops, consoles and phones

usb-c-charger.name: GaN USB-C chargers
usb-c-charger.card_title: One small charger for every device
usb-c-charger.card_text: A multi-port GaN charger can power a laptop, phone and tablet from a single plug.
usb-c-charger.kit_line: One compact charger for laptop, phone and tablet

power-station.name: Portable power stations
power-station.card_title: Keep devices charged when the power is out
power-station.card_text: A portable power station stores enough energy to charge phones and laptops or run small appliances during a power cut or a trip.
power-station.kit_line: Battery power for phones, laptops and small appliances, at home or away

telescope.name: Beginner telescopes
telescope.card_title: See the night sky for yourself
telescope.card_text: A beginner telescope shows the Moon's craters and Jupiter's largest moons from a backyard.
telescope.kit_line: A first telescope for the Moon and planets

tenergy.name: Tenergy rechargeable batteries
tenergy.kit_line: Rechargeable batteries and chargers (Tenergy ships within the US)

contabo-ai.name: Contabo servers for AI models
contabo-ai.card_title: Run an AI model on your own server
contabo-ai.card_text: Open models such as DeepSeek can run on a rented server instead of someone else's app, so prompts and data stay on a machine you control.
contabo-ai.kit_line: A rented server set up for running open AI models yourself

corel.name: Corel creative software
corel.card_title: Design, photo and PDF tools for your computer
corel.card_text: Corel makes CorelDRAW, PaintShop Pro and WordPerfect for Windows, with CorelDRAW also on Mac, sold as one-time purchases or subscriptions.
corel.kit_line: Design, photo-editing and office software for Windows and Mac

fields._note: Older articles saved with toolkit 'general' use their field instead (the second tag).

overrides._note: Articles published before the tech-news remap, re-sorted with the current rules (slug: category).
